metadata.title: OPC Bridge — Experimental OPC Initiatives Showcase
metadata.description: The official showcase platform for OPC experimental initiatives: AI decision intelligence, graph world models, smart rail monitoring, and maintenance agents.

hero.subtitle: Four flagship projects fusing AI, knowledge graphs, and edge-cloud computing — engineered to redefine decision intelligence for the railway industry and beyond.

projects.sectionSubtitle: Each project demonstrates a production-ready capability — from data fusion platforms to field-service agents — built to attract global investment.

contact.title: Let's Build the Future Together
contact.subtitle: We are seeking global investors and strategic partners to accelerate our experimental OPC initiatives. Reach out to discuss investment opportunities, pilots, and collaborations.
